label: Nothing has actuality except insofar as it is: whatever is in act in some respect…, from perfection
meaning: Whatever is in act in a respect is perfect in it (q.5 a.1, STMT-PERFECT-INSOFAR-AS-IN-ACT), and whatever is perfect in some respect has being (q.4 a.2, STMT-PERFECT-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING, encoded from the definition-linked q.4 a.2 statement). Derives STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING (q.4 a.1 ad 3), an underived leaf of every root route. Act and perfection are read per respect with one InAct parameter (DISAMB-IN-ACT). Both premises stay open.
